But keeping all of B replicated on every rank costs n^2 memory per rank, which could become a real bottleneck for very large n, so I'm weighing whether to generate B differently to save memory.\n\nI could try having each rank generate only its own rows of B while advancing the RNG state through skipped entries cheaply, but since computing A requires the full B matrix on every rank anyway, there's no way around replicating B fully unless I restructure to circulate row data — so I'll just accept keeping full B per rank and free it after A is computed.\n\nI'll use MPI_Wtime for timing instead of high_resolution_clock, keep the same output format, and use -O3 -march=native for the build. For the code structure I'm setting up rank/size globals, a helper to determine which rank owns a given row under cyclic distribution, and a function to compute how many rows a given rank owns.\n\nWriting distribution helper functions...\n\nNow I'm writing the Cholesky decomposition routine itself: it iterates column by column, determines which rank owns each pivot row, computes the diagonal element by subtracting the sum of squares of prior entries, and checks for non-positive values that would indicate the matrix isn't positive definite.\n\nI'm working out how to broadcast the pivot row along with a failure flag packed into the same buffer so all ranks learn the result in one message, and considering how to handle the error case cleanly so only one rank reports the failure.\n\nThen I'm having each rank update its locally owned rows below the pivot: subtracting the dot product of prior columns weighted by the pivot row, then dividing by the pivot diagonal value for the owned rows beyond the pivot.\n\nI verify the local row index formula maps correctly to global row indices greater than the pivot, and confirm the column dependencies use already-finalized values from earlier steps. I also check that rank-0's failure detection broadcasts consistently so all ranks exit the loop together, and that the diagonal check for singularity happens in the right order relative to off-diagonal updates within the same row.\n\nNow I'm writing the gather function that collects each process's local rows back into the full matrix on rank 0...\n\nI'm worried about a potential deadlock here: blocking sends from non-root ranks could stall if rank 0 isn't ready to receive that particular row yet, especially since each rank sends its rows in sequence and rank 0 processes rows in index order too, so the ordering has to line up correctly to avoid everyone waiting on each other.\n\nNow I'm writing the function to generate a symmetric positive-definite matrix locally on each rank, where I build a random matrix B, then compute each local row of A as a dot product of rows of B, adding a diagonal boost of n to ensure positive-definiteness.\n\nActually A[i][j] equals A[j][i] exactly since the dot products use the same terms in the same order, so symmetry could halve the generation work, though it's not strictly necessary here.\n\nNow I'm setting up the MPI main function: initializing rank and size, parsing arguments on all ranks, but restricting usage-error printing to rank 0 via a small rootPrintf helper that checks the rank before calling printf, while being mindful of format-string warnings when the format isn't a literal.\n\nActually, cleaner to extract the whole flow into a separate function that returns an exit code, with main just handling MPI_Init/Finalize — avoids messy jumps. Then I'm setting up timing with a barrier before capturing the start time.\n\nFor correctness, I'm reducing elapsed times across ranks with MPI_MAX since some ranks finish computation slightly later despite the broadcasts syncing most work, so taking the max gives an accurate wall-clock duration for rank 0 to report, converting to milliseconds afterward.\n\nThen for output: I need to gather the full matrix back together if printing results, validate by comparing the original matrix against L on rank 0, and broadcast that validity boolean to all ranks so everyone agrees on the final success/failure status returned by the program. I'm keeping all the header and progress prints restricted to rank 0 only, ensuring output ordering stays sensible around the gather and timing calls.\n\nI'll keep validateCholesky and the print functions unchanged since they only run on rank 0, while choleskyDecomposition and generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix get the MPI treatment. {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1793032766775,"sessionID":"ses_e86ecd420ffemXilJ1kyh739jQ","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"toolu_01KMYoGdsuhUDuSMp7Q2wCRP","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261025-170040/cholesky_claude-haiku-5.5-oc-medium_mpi_r3/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","content":"#include <algorithm>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Distributed-memory Cholesky decomposition (MPI, row-cyclic distribution)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Data layout: global row i is owned by rank (i % P) and stored at local row\n// index (i / P) in a row-major local buffer of (localRows x n) doubles.\n//\n// Algorithm (right-looking over pivot rows, bit-identical to the sequential\n// row-oriented algorithm because every dot product is accumulated in the same\n// k = 0..j-1 order):\n//   for j = 0 .. n-1:\n//     owner(j) finishes row j (diagonal L[j][j]) and broadcasts L[j][0..j]\n//     every rank updates its owned rows i > j: L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - dot) / L[j][j]\n\nnamespace {\n\nint g_rank = 0;  // rank of this process in MPI_COMM_WORLD (set in main)\n\n// Print only from rank 0 so output matches the sequential program.\ntemplate <typename... Args>\nvoid rootPrintf(const char* fmt, Args... args) {\n    if (g_rank == 0) {\n        printf(fmt, args...);\n    }\n}\n\n// Number of rows owned by `rank` in a cyclic distribution of n rows over `size` ranks.\nsize_t localRowCount(const size_t n, const int rank, const int size) {\n    const size_t r = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t p = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    return r < n ? (n - r + p - 1) / p : 0;\n}\n\n}  // namespace\n\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition.\n// `A` holds this rank's rows (localRowCount x n, row-major). On success every\n// rank's owned rows contain the corresponding rows of L (upper part zeroed).\n// Returns the same value on all ranks.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const int rank, const int size) {\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    const size_t R = static_cast<size_t>(rank);\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n\n    // Pivot buffer: L[j][0..j] followed by a failure flag at index j+1.\n    std::vector<double> pivot(n + 1);\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n        const size_t owner = j % P;\n        const size_t lj = j / P;\n        double failed = 0.0;\n\n        // Owner finalizes pivot row j: diagonal element and zeroed upper part.\n        if (owner == R) {\n            double* rowj = &A[lj * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += rowj[k] * rowj[k];\n            }\n            const double val = rowj[j] - sum;\n            if (val <= 0.0) {\n                // Matrix is not positive definite\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                failed = 1.0;\n            } else {\n                rowj[j] = sqrt(val);\n                for (size_t k = j + 1; k < n; ++k) {\n                    rowj[k] = 0.0;\n                }\n            }\n            std::copy(rowj, rowj + j + 1, pivot.begin());\n            pivot[j + 1] = failed;\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(pivot.data(), static_cast<int>(j + 2), MPI_DOUBLE, static_cast<int>(owner), MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (pivot[j + 1] != 0.0) {\n            return false;  // identical decision on all ranks\n        }\n\n        const double* pj = pivot.data();\n        const double djj = pj[j];\n\n        // Update owned rows i > j. Local index li corresponds to global row R + li*P.\n        size_t li = (j >= R) ? (j - R) / P + 1 : 0;\n        for (; li < nloc; ++li) {\n            double* row = &A[li * n];\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                sum += row[k] * pj[k];\n            }\n            row[j] = (row[j] - sum) / djj;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix (this rank's rows only).\n// Every rank regenerates the same B from the fixed seed, so the result is\n// identical to the sequential generator.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n, const int rank, const int size) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    // Compute owned rows of A = B * B^T\n    const size_t nloc = localRowCount(n, rank, size);\n    A.assign(nloc * n, 0.0);\n    for (size_t li = 0; li < nloc; ++li) {\n        const size_t i = static_cast<size_t>(rank) + li * static_cast<size_t>(size);\n        double* row = &A[li * n];\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            row[j] = sum;\n        }\n        // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n        row[i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\n// Gather the row-distributed matrix into a full row-major n x n matrix on rank 0.\nvoid gatherMatrix(const std::vector<double>& local, const size_t n, const int rank, const int size,\n                  std::vector<double>& full) {\n    const size_t P = static_cast<size_t>(size);\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        full.assign(n * n, 0.0);\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const int owner = static_cast<int>(i % P);\n        const size_t li = i / P;\n        if (owner == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                std::copy(&local[li * n], &local[li * n] + n, &full[i * n]);\n            }\n        } else if (rank == owner) {\n            MPI_Send(&local[li * n], static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, 0, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        } else if (rank == 0) {\n            MPI_Recv(&full[i * n], static_cast<int>(n), MPI_DOUBLE, owner, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Validation runs on rank 0 with the gathered matrices.\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n\n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n\n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nstatic int runBenchmark(int argc, char** argv, const int rank, const int size) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on all ranks; only rank 0 prints)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    rootPrintf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    rootPrintf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    rootPrintf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", size);\n\n    // Generate positive definite matrix (distributed by rows)\n    rootPrintf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    std::vector<double> A;\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    if (validate) {\n        gatherMatrix(A, n, rank, size, A_orig);  // Save original for validation\n    }\n\n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    rootPrintf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    const bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n, rank, size);\n\n    const double elapsed = MPI_Wtime() - start;\n    double maxElapsed = elapsed;\n    MPI_Reduce(&elapsed, &maxElapsed, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n    if (!success) {\n
